description:
Single-use ticket response. Debug output always redacts bearer material.

The issuer must generate the ticket with a CSPRNG and persist only a keyed
digest of its secret. The server-side record must retain the complete claim
set (`principal_id`, `audience`, `desktop_id`, `desktop_generation`, `origin`,
`mode`, and expiry) plus a consumed flag. A viewer upgrade must atomically
look up and consume that record while checking the current time and every
claim; wire-shape validation alone is not authorization.

audience.description: Exact endpoint class allowed to consume the bearer.

desktop_generation.description: Exact desktop lifetime authorized for viewing.

expires_at.description: Strictly later expiry, no more than sixty seconds after issue.

origin.description: Origin required at the browser WebSocket upgrade.

principal_id.description: Authenticated principal for whom the server minted this ticket.

ticket.description: Secret returned once and stored only as a keyed digest by the server.
